note: Goal -> model mapping for SAFE recommended camera positions. Numbers in rationale come from catalog.json (spec sheets). Output is an inferred recommendation: confirm mount, power, Wi-Fi signal and distance on site.
poe_note: PoE models (T1, F1) pair with the N85 8-ch PoE NVR (802.3at/af, up to 5MP per channel). One N85 = max 8 cameras.
cable_note: Ethernet runs over ~100 m need a switch/extender (Ethernet standard, not from the spec sheet).

why.E1: Longest outdoor Identify (6.6 m), auto-tracks a person at the door, 110 dB siren; Wi-Fi 6, needs 12 V.
why.T1: Fixed view on the door, Identify 6.5 m, 20 m night, IP66; PoE.
why.F1: Identify 6.5 m on the widest fixed outdoor lens (94.5 deg H), red/blue lights + siren; PoE.
why.D1: Only at a doorbell position: Identify 3.5 m, 152 deg H, face recognition (Vyanet Cloud).
why.V5P: Same lens as T1 on Wi-Fi + 12 V; sheet publishes Detect only.
why.S2: No power at the door: solar/battery, Identify 5.6 m, 10 m night, 2.4 GHz Wi-Fi only.

doorbell_visitor.label: Front door with doorbell: visitor + face

why.D1: Replaces the bell on existing 8-24 V AC wiring; Identify 3.5 m, 170 deg diag, face recognition, visitor messages.
why.T1: If faces stand back >3.5 m: Identify 6.5 m, PoE.
why.E1: Identify 6.6 m and tracks a visitor walking the porch; needs 12 V.
why.S2: No doorbell wiring or outlet: solar/battery, Identify 5.6 m.

why.E1: Longest outdoor Recognise (13.3 m) and auto-tracks a vehicle up the drive (355 deg pan), vehicle detection, 110 dB siren; 12 V.
why.T1: Fixed view down the drive, vehicle detection, Recognise 13.1 m / Observe 25.9 m, 20 m night; PoE.
why.F1: Recognise 13.0 m with red/blue lights + siren for after-hours arrivals; PoE.
why.V5P: Vehicle detection, 20 m night on Wi-Fi + 12 V; sheet publishes Detect (65.3 m) only.
why.S2: No power at the entry: solar/battery, Recognise 11.3 m, night range only 10 m, 2.4 GHz Wi-Fi must reach.

wide_yard_overview.label: Wide lot / yard / open land overview

why.E1: Coverage by sweep: pans 355 deg and auto-tracks across the yard; Observe 26.4 m, Detect 66.4 m, 20 m night; 12 V.
why.F1: Widest fixed outdoor view (94.5 deg H), Observe 25.9 m, lights + siren on detection; PoE.
why.T1: Fixed 91.6 deg H, Observe 25.9 m, 20 m night; PoE.
why.V5P: Fixed 91.6 deg H, Detect 65.3 m, 20 m night on Wi-Fi + 12 V.
why.S2: No power: solar/battery, 89 deg H, Observe 22.4 m, 10 m night.

street_frontage_property_edge.label: Street frontage / property edge (watch the property, not the road)
street_frontage_property_edge.aim: Aim along the property edge or into the yard, not across the street; coverage width matters more than reach.

why.E1: Aim at the property side, not the road: pans 355 deg to sweep the frontage yard and its walk-in points; Observe 26.4 m, auto-tracking, 110 dB siren; 12 V.
why.F1: Widest fixed outdoor view (94.5 deg H) aimed along the property edge, not across the road; Observe 25.9 m, lights + siren; PoE.
why.T1: Fixed 91.6 deg H aimed along the frontage, Observe 25.9 m; PoE.
why.S2: No power at the frontage: solar/battery, 89 deg H, Observe 22.4 m, 10 m night; aim along the property edge.

perimeter_fence_line.label: Perimeter / long fence line (open yard side)

why.E1: Coverage by sweep: one PT dome pans 355 deg to cover two fence legs and auto-tracks; Observe 26.4 m, 20 m night; 12 V.
why.F1: Widest fixed outdoor view (94.5 deg H) along the fence, Observe 25.9 m, lights + siren; PoE.
why.T1: Fixed 91.6 deg H, Observe 25.9 m: plan one per ~20-25 m of fence; PoE.
why.V5P: Fixed 91.6 deg H on Wi-Fi + 12 V, 20 m night.
why.S2: Unpowered fence line: solar, Observe 22.4 m, 10 m night.

side_yard_corridor.label: Narrow side yard / corridor (walls both sides)
side_yard_corridor.aim: Aim down the length of the strip; a wide or panning view mostly sees the walls.

why.T1: Reach along the strip matters more than width: fixed view down the corridor, Observe 25.9 m, 20 m night; PoE.
why.F1: Same Observe 25.9 m plus red/blue lights + siren where nobody else watches the blind side; PoE.
why.V5P: Fixed bullet down the strip, 20 m night on Wi-Fi + 12 V; sheet publishes Detect only.
why.S2: No power in the side yard: solar, Observe 22.4 m, 10 m night.

why.F1: Flashing red/blue lights + spotlight + 100 dB siren on detection; widest outdoor lens 94.5 deg H; Recognise 13.0 m; PoE.
why.E1: 110 dB siren (loudest) and auto-tracking across the lot; Recognise 13.3 m; 12 V.
why.V5P: Alarm-linked spotlight + 100 dB siren, vehicle detection; Wi-Fi + 12 V.
why.T1: Spotlight + 100 dB siren, Recognise 13.1 m; PoE, lower profile.
why.S2: No power in the lot: 110 dB siren + spotlight, solar; 10 m night.

motor_court_tracking.label: Motor court / arrival court: follow arrivals

why.E1: Auto-tracking pan/tilt (355 deg) follows vehicles and people; Recognise 13.3 m, 110 dB siren; 12 V.
why.F1: After-hours arrivals get red/blue lights + siren; 94.5 deg H, Recognise 13.0 m; PoE.
why.T1: Fixed view of the court mouth, Recognise 13.1 m, vehicle detection; PoE.

remote_outbuilding_no_power.label: Remote outbuilding / gate with no power

why.S2: Only catalog camera without wired power: 10000 mAh battery + 5 W solar, Recognise 11.3 m, 110 dB siren; 2.4 GHz Wi-Fi only.
why.V5P: If 12 V is available at the building: 20 m night, vehicle detection, Wi-Fi.
why.E1: If 12 V is available: pan/tilt tracking around the building, Wi-Fi 6.

indoor_common_area.label: Indoor common area / lobby / large office

why.M1: 8MP, 108 deg H, Identify 7.1 m (best indoor), mmWave radar 360 deg auto-tracking; USB-C 5 V.
why.P1: Widest view 111.4 deg H, Identify 5.2 m, manual pan/tilt; USB-C, <4.8 W.
why.R5: Identify 5.9 m but narrower 77.8 deg H and 15 fps at 5MP; USB-C, no Ethernet.

why.P1: 111.4 deg H covers a small room from a corner, Identify 5.2 m; USB-C, <4.8 W.
why.R5: Identify 5.9 m, 350 deg pan to aim at a desk or door; Wi-Fi b/g/n only.

ranking_note: Models are ranked by fit to the goal, not by a default favourite: coverage width / sweep for overview, perimeter and frontage; deterrence for lots; Identify range for entries; Recognise range for driveways; reach along the length for narrow corridors. No catalog camera has a 180 deg view: widest outdoor fixed is F1 at 94.5 deg H, E1 is 90.7 deg H but pans 355 deg, D1 is 152 deg H but is a doorbell only.
